And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Alok Kumar Srivastava,Jitendra Vikram Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Lavania,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned AGA for the State as well as perused the record.

The present application has been filed for the following main relief:-
"It is, therefore, Most Respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to allow this petition under sec. 482 Cr.P.C. now 528 B.N.S.S. and Set-a-side the impugned summoning order dated 05-03- 2024 passed by the Court of Civil Judge (J.D.)/ F.T.C., C.A.W., Lucknow, in Case Crime No. 0269 of 2023, under Ketki And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ...

sentences.text:
on 9 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161272362/
1 Section Under Section 498A, 323,504 506 IPC Police Station- Mahanagar District- LUCKNOW, (ANNEXURE NO. 2) and also quash the Charge-sheet dated 25-12-2023 (ANNEXURE NO. 3) submitted in, Section 498A, 323,504 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act submitted in the aforesaid case, otherwise the applicant will suffer an irreparable loss."

After arguing at some length, learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that liberty may be given to the applicants to file bail application before the trial court which may be decided in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil versus Central Bureau of Investigation and another, (2022) 10 S.C.R. 351: (2022) 10 SCC 51 as also to prefer a discharge application before the court below and the same may be decided expeditiously.
Learned AGA has no objection to the prayer made by learned counsel for the applicants.
Keeping in view the aforesaid, the present application is disposed of with liberty as prayed for and with a direction to the court below that if the applicants apply for bail before the Court concerned,
his prayer for bail shall be considered and decided expeditiously in accordance with law.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil versus Central Bureau of Investigation and another, (2022) 10 S.C.R. 351: (2022) 10 SCC 51
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Liberty is also granted to the applicants to move discharge application before the court below and the same shall be decided expeditiously in accordance with law.

Taking note of the facts of the case and also the observation made in the case ofSatendra Kumar Antil (Supra), this Court is of the view that it would be appropriate to observe that it is expected from the Police Officer concerned that for a period of 30 days from today or till the applicants apply for bail, whichever is earlier, he would not take any coercive action against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
With the aforesaid observations, the present application is disposed of.

Order Date :- 9.9.2024 Jyoti/-
